crons.name: autoresearch-incident-latency
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/autoresearch/SKILL.md and execute the experiment loop for cycle incident_response_latency. ACTIVITY GATE: first check for failure-trigger tasks created in the last 24h via `cortextos bus list-tasks --agent devops --format json` filtered by title LIKE 'failure-trigger:%' AND created_at > 24h ago. If zero new failure-trigger tasks found, log 'incident_response_latency: no new failures in 24h — skipping measurement' and stop. Only run the full experiment loop if >=1 new failure-trigger task exists in the window.

crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, scan pending tasks for failure-keyword titles and triage immediately (do not defer), then work on your highest priority task. If no active tasks exist (cortextos bus list-tasks --status in_progress returns empty), skip non-essential work and defer to next heartbeat.

crons.name: tmp-cleanup
crons.prompt: Run scripts/tmp-cleanup.sh from this agent's working directory. The script deletes /tmp/_*.txt and /tmp/*.txt older than 24h, /tmp/.tmp* dirs older than 24h (Claude Code temp dirs), and /tmp/*.vhost + /tmp/*.sh staging files older than 48h. Excludes system dirs (.ICE-unix .X11-unix .font-unix .XIM-unix) and .remember. Reports removed count + bytes freed. Schedule: 04:00 UTC daily.

crons.name: heartbeat-stamp
crons.prompt: Mid-session heartbeat. Step 1: `cortextos bus update-cron-fire heartbeat-stamp --interval 1h` (registers the fire in cron-state.json so the daemon gap-detector stops nudging — see writer's bug_cron_state_drift.md). Step 2: `cortextos bus update-heartbeat "active — mid-session"` to stamp the dashboard. Skip the full heartbeat checklist; this is just the cadence ping for analyst/chief during multi-hour sessions.

crons.name: fred-vixcls-refresh
crons.prompt: Refresh FRED VIXCLS.csv for analyst MNQ research. Run: curl -s 'https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=VIXCLS' -o /home/claude-dev/repos/orbfutures/data/VIXCLS.csv && echo "VIXCLS refreshed: $(tail -1 /home/claude-dev/repos/orbfutures/data/VIXCLS.csv)". Log success silently. On failure, log the error and move on.

crons.name: autoresearch-infra-throughput
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/autoresearch/SKILL.md and execute the experiment loop for cycle infra_task_throughput.

crons.name: aitheist-orphan-sweep
crons.prompt: Aitheist orphan render-job sweep. Step 1: `cortextos bus update-cron-fire aitheist-orphan-sweep --interval 30m` (registers the fire so the daemon gap-detector stops nudging). Step 2: `cd /home/claude-dev/repos/ai-theist && node scripts/sweep-orphan-render-jobs.mjs`. If output ends with 'no orphans' — acknowledge silently with one short line. If orphans were swept — report the count + first few IDs and post an event log. Script threshold is 20 min pending; cron fires every 30 min so max detection latency ~50 min.

crons.name: daily-context-reset
crons.prompt: Preventive context-reset hard-restart. Quickly: (1) update heartbeat to scheduled context reset, (2) save any in-flight state to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, (3) run cortextos bus hard-restart --reason daily-context-reset. This keeps context from accumulating.

crons.name: forward-test-refresh
crons.prompt: Run the orbfutures forward test to refresh /tmp/orb_status.json. Command: cd /home/claude-dev/repos/orbfutures && python3 -m backtest.forward_test --instruments MCL --window 30 2>&1 | tail -5. Log output to memory. If it errors, log the error and report to analyst.

crons.name: h137-monitor
crons.prompt: Run H137 live monitoring: bash /home/claude-dev/cortextos/orgs/prop-firm-admin/scripts/h137-monitor.sh and report output. If TRIPWIRE RED: immediately send-message chief urgent with the output and create a failure-trigger task. If TRIPWIRE YELLOW: send-message analyst normal with output. If OK or 0 trades: log silently.
crons.note: Post-close: 21:30 UTC = 4:30 PM ET, after MES session EOD exit. Run manually on day 1 regardless of cron fire.
